data.one_liner: Change app icon at runtime on Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter plugin that lets you switch the app icon while the app is running. It works on both Android and iOS by enabling/disabling activity aliases or setting alternate icons via the platform APIs.
use_when: You need to change the app icon based on user choice or app state
You want a runtime icon change without rebuilding the app
avoid_when: You only need a single icon or want to change icons at build time
Your app targets platforms that do not support runtime icon changes
strengths: Simple API with isSupported, getCurrentIcon, and setIcon methods
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration in AndroidManifest and Info.plist
Not supported on all devices (e.g., some Android OEMs may ignore alias changes)
data.setup_notes: Add activity-alias entries in AndroidManifest.xml and alternate icons in iOS Info.plist and Assets.xcassets. No build_runner or codegen needed.
